title: Glowing sneaker
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- glow aura behind shoe -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='65' rx='42' ry='22' fill='#1a3a5c' opacity='0.6'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='65' rx='34' ry='16' fill='#2a5a8c' opacity='0.5'/>
  
  <!-- sole -->
  <path d='M18 70 Q20 78 30 80 L78 80 Q88 78 86 70 L84 64 L20 64 Z' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <path d='M18 70 Q20 78 30 80 L78 80 Q88 78 86 70 L84 64 L20 64 Z' fill='none' stroke='#b0b8d0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- sole glow lines -->
  <line x1='24' y1='72' x2='80' y2='72' stroke='#7af0ff' stroke-width='2' opacity='0.8'/>
  <line x1='22' y1='76' x2='82' y2='76' stroke='#7af0ff' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.5'/>
  
  <!-- shoe body main -->
  <path d='M20 64 L20 44 Q20 36 30 36 L52 36 Q62 36 68 42 L82 54 Q86 58 86 64 Z' fill='#e04040'/>
  
  <!-- toe cap lighter -->
  <path d='M62 36 Q70 38 78 48 Q84 54 86 64 L72 64 Q70 54 64 46 Z' fill='#f06868'/>
  
  <!-- heel tab -->
  <path d='M20 44 Q20 36 30 36 L34 36 L34 50 L20 50 Z' fill='#b02020'/>
  
  <!-- tongue -->
  <path d='M36 36 Q38 26 46 24 Q52 24 54 30 L56 36 Z' fill='#f0d040'/>
  <path d='M38 34 Q40 28 46 27 Q50 27 52 31 Z' fill='#fff080'/>
  
  <!-- laces -->
  <line x1='40' y1='40' x2='56' y2='40' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='40' y1='46' x2='58' y2='46' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='40' y1='52' x2='60' y2='52' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- lace holes -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='40' r='1.8' fill='#f0d040'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='46' r='1.8' fill='#f0d040'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='52' r='1.8' fill='#f0d040'/>
  
  <!-- swoosh / stripe -->
  <path d='M28 60 Q45 48 60 50 Q72 52 78 60' fill='none' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='3.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  
  <!-- glowing lights on sole -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='68' r='2.5' fill='#7af0ff'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='68' r='2.5' fill='#7af0ff'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='68' r='2.5' fill='#7af0ff'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='68' r='2.5' fill='#7af0ff'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='68' r='2.5' fill='#7af0ff'/>
  
  <!-- glow highlights -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='68' r='4' fill='#7af0ff' opacity='0.3'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='68' r='4' fill='#7af0ff' opacity='0.3'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='68' r='4' fill='#7af0ff' opacity='0.3'/>
  
  <!-- shine on toe -->
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='52' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.4' transform='rotate(-20 74 52)'/>
</svg>
